questionSnapshot.question: In Pocahontas (1995), which human friend does Pocahontas confide in about John Smith?

notes: Read all four answers and relevant full topic digests/category context; checked cross-bank matches, wording, scope, category and editorial difficulty. Original best-friend wording allowed animal-friend readings. Specified the human confidante about Smith. Licensed reader activities establish Nakoma’s secret and Kocoum’s separate discovery; Disney dialogue corroborates confidence promise. This concerns the fictional film, not historical Pocahontas.

verification.context: In Pocahontas (1995), which human friend does Pocahontas confide in about John Smith?

premise.reason: Nakoma is the human friend who knows the secret and later tells Kocoum.

sources.locator: Licensed Disney reader teaching notes, page 2 characters: Nakoma best friend, Kocoum expected husband, Willow tree spirit; activities 4–5 distinguish Nakoma’s knowledge of Smith from Kocoum’s discovery/attack.
Nakoma dialogue: confidence promise and refusal to lie again; Kocoum asks that Pocahontas be told to stop running off. Confidante and intended suitor have different roles.
Opening explicitly names Flit hummingbird and Meeko raccoon; Willow tree spirit and Kocoum warrior distinguished.
